results.cypher: MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2404.04940"}) MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> seed.arxiv_id RETURN DISTINCT p.arxiv_id AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.title AS title, p.primary_category AS primary_category ORDER BY title LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2404.04940"}), (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(q:ArxivPaper) WHERE q.arxiv_id <> p.arxiv_id RETURN q.title AS answer_value, a.name AS author, q.primary_category AS primary_category, q.arxiv_id AS arxiv_id, [q.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY answer_value LIMIT 25
